info.name: Heurist API - Verified Test Suite
info.description: Verified Heurist API beta test suite for routing, public access, authentication, definitions, records, map presentation, GeoJSON, timeline data, IIIF, and annotations.

item.name: Guest access to private record returns empty

exec: pm.test('private record hidden from guest', function () { pm.expect(body.records.length).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Guest access to public record succeeds

exec: pm.test('public record visible to guest', function () { pm.expect(body.records.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Public definition response is returned', function () { pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('private record visible after session login', function () { pm.expect(body.records.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('private record visible with JWT', function () { pm.expect(body.records.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('record structure collection returned', function () { pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.meta.entity).to.eql('recstructure'); });
pm.test('Invalid token message', function () { pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Invalid token'); });

pm.test('API error envelope uses Heurist status constant', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.status).to.eql(401); pm.expect(errorBody.error).to.eql('denied'); pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: fields adds fields but preserves mandatory envelope

exec: pm.test('IDs-only DTO is returned', function () { pm.expect(body.ids).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body).to.include.keys('total','offset','limit','resultToken'); });
pm.test('next is present when more records exist', function () { if (body.pagination.total > body.records.length) { pm.expect(body.pagination.next).to.be.a('string'); } });

item.name: Private record remains hidden from guest

exec: pm.test('public source record is returned', function () { pm.expect(body.records.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('direct field metadata uses dty_PathCode', function () { pm.expect(body.meta.fields.details[0].dty_PathCode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('rtyId') + ':' + pm.environment.get('dtyId')); });
pm.test('invalid request error is returned', function () { pm.expect(body).to.have.property('message'); });

item.name: POST records with linked field path

exec: pm.test('linked values preserve path provenance', function () { const code = pm.environment.get('linkedDetailPath'); const values = body.records[0] && body.records[0].details && body.records[0].details[code]; if (values && values.length) { pm.expect(values[0].path).to.include.keys('id','recordIDs'); } });

item.name: 8. Map and timeline API

request.description: Returns the public engine-neutral RT_MAP_DOCUMENT representation.
Returns the public engine-neutral RT_MAP_LAYER representation.
Returns a file-backed KML/KMZ/CSV/TSV/GeoJSON/SHP datasource as GeoJSON. The datasource route is GET-only.
Verifies that POST is reserved for ordinary map record/query searches and is not accepted by /map/data/{recordId}.

item.description: Public MapDocument/MapLayer presentation, Heurist record/query GeoJSON, file-backed datasource, and timeline endpoints. MapDocument/MapLayer/data routes are GET-only; POST is supported for ordinary map and timeline queries. Configure the map-related environment values before running.
